response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), kept AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.overall_avg FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept
